correctness.rationale: The one-step indexed cyclic Rule-22 inverse fiber equals tr(M_y0...M_y(n-1)), including repeated positions at n=1,2. The homogeneous count 1+T_n follows from block charpoly t^3-t²-1. I checked actual integer certificate/proof scripts: simultaneous singular-value bounds exclude outputs containing >=4 ones; Perron residual powers 3,4,5 have Frobenius norms below 1 and hence bound long sparse words; exactly 15,250 sparse outputs at n<=24 are checked by integer transfer matrices. Independent direct evaluation of all 2^n inputs for n=1..12 corroborates maximum uniqueness and recurrence. This proves correctness; the decisive issue is earlier identical theorem, not mathematics. Nonzero targets can have zero preimages; that is included in comparison.
